# FinSoft repository instructions

For every task that creates, changes, reviews, or discusses UI, UX, styling, frontend components, forms, tables, drawers, navigation, or responsive behavior, first read and follow [the FinSoft Ant Design system](../DESIGN_SYSTEM.md).

Before creating or changing a business feature, workflow, data model, validation rule, role, or navigation behavior, first read [the FinSoft business and user-flow guide](../BUSINESS_AND_USER_FLOWS.md).

The design system applies to all UI components. Preserve existing project architecture and avoid unrelated refactoring.

The `FinSoft Ant Design` custom agent is the preferred agent for this repository. Its rules are also mandatory regardless of which agent is currently selected: use Ant Design components and tokens only, keep input sizes, typography, drawers, data tables, and primary buttons consistent, and do not introduce custom visual design patterns or another UI library.
